claim: h1: Suyudi Ario Seto is the current Kapolri and spoke about the case of a former Kapolri (Listyo)
h2/caption: Kapolri said the case 'tidak ada kaitannya dengan persaingan' (verbatim); repeated verbatim in s11 (paid off, no interpretation of 'persaingan')
s1–s2: Tuesday 3 Nov 2026, Bareskrim named three suspects in alleged illegal tapping; one is former Kapolri Listyo Sigit Prabowo
s3: per police, the allegedly tapped numbers include the President's number
s4: when named suspect Listyo was Kepala Staf Kepresidenan
s5: one day later, Wednesday 4 Nov, the Istana (Mensesneg) announced the President signed a Keppres dismissing Listyo as KSP

s6–s7/caption: KSPSI (AGN) removed Listyo temporarily ('untuk sementara waktu', Sekjen Hermanto Ahmad) as Ketua Dewan Penasihat; Andi Gani: 'Langsung diberhentikan'. Exact decision date differs by outlet (Kompas 3 Nov 'dinonaktifkan', Harian Jogja/Antara 4 Nov, detik 5 Nov), so no date is spoken

s8/caption: per KSPSI AGN Sekjen Hermanto Ahmad, the removal becomes permanent only with a final, binding court ruling ('yang bersangkutan akan diberhentikan secara permanen' after putusan berkekuatan hukum tetap)

s10–s11/caption: Thursday 5 Nov (no time of day given; 'siang' dropped), at Gedung Utama Mabes Polri, while receiving PP Persatuan Purnawirawan Polri, Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto said the case is 'murni dalam bentuk penegakan hukum' (verbatim). Light-FC flag resolved: quote verified in detik 15:48 WIB

s13/caption: Thursday night 5 Nov, Bareskrim (Dirtipidsiber Brigjen Suhermanto) announced a 4th suspect with initials SU (police gave initials only, Antara); per media (CNN Indonesia) SU = Irjen Slamet Uliandi, former Kadiv TIK Polri (also Dewan Pembina Monitoring Center Bareskrim)

s14: per police (Suhermanto, verbatim in CNN: 'Tersangka SU meng-ACC melakukan penghapusan terhadap file hasil penyadapan'), in October 2026 after a request from Irjen Ahrie Sonta Nasution. One source (CNN); full FC: OK as attributed

s15–s16/caption: unlike the other three, Slamet is not yet detained ('belum ditahan'); Suhermanto: 'belum bisa kita lakukan penahanan karena dalam kondisi sakit pasca stroke'; the other three are detained (CNN/Antara: Rutan Mako Brimob; PART 2 said 'Rutan Mabes Polri' per detik, so no location is spoken)
s17: suspect status is not a verdict; courts decide (presumption of innocence, general legal principle)
s19/caption: as of Friday morning 6 Nov 2026 we found no response from Listyo or his lawyer, and no praperadilan filing (searches 6 Nov; detik Kapolri and CNN Slamet articles carry none)
s20/caption: on motive, the Istana is waiting for the investigation
caption: alleged offences = illegal tapping, deleting electronic data, illegal access
